criteria.description: The exit-8 strict result remains retained qualified evidence rather than being discarded or retried.
A complete per-source no-match under fast selection remains incomplete and never becomes proof of absence.
Selection, verification, source counts, frontier, usage, and top-level decisions remain exact and separate.
No query fragment, source canary, target coordinate, JQL, URL, narrative, user, app, or property identity appears.
The answer contains only the requested structured projection.
